title: world.shapes
description: The world's shape data, in parts after the world.slots parts (on join and whenever a build publishes): the shape index (doc index: the text of shape_index.json, protocol/world/shape_index.schema.json) and the shape map (doc map: Base64 of the deflated bytes of shape_map.bin). Ids, tile numbers and hashes only; never geometry or art. Sent only when the shape map's header names the published WorldIndex.

doc.description: Which document the part belongs to.

hash.description: SHA-256 of this document's whole transmitted text.
